citation: Hiroki Nakano, Takashi Koide, and Daiki Chiba. ScamFerret: Detecting Scam Websites Autonomously with Large Language Models. DIMVA 2025, Springer.
labels: Published groundtruth_url.txt path classes; not independently re-adjudicated.

labeling_audit.reported_candidate_collection_window: 2024-04-01 through 2024-04-07; not a per-row snapshot timestamp
labeling_audit.adjudication: Section 4 describes Tranco top-100k exclusion, HTTP-200 accessibility, consensus inspection by three security engineers using search engines, content and screenshots, then balanced sampling.
labeling_audit.provider_circularity: Google Safe Browsing, OpenPhish and WHOIS age are not specified as labeling rules. Undisclosed dependencies of upstream candidate sources cannot be excluded.
labeling_audit.content_circularity: Content informed manual adjudication; labels are not independently observed financial outcomes. No claim of blind content-independent truth.

dataset_subset: dataset; three English categories; 200 published URLs per category/class before exclusions
features: Production URL normalization, static scanner extract_html, and raw WHOIS records only.

date_semantics.content_observedAt: Pinned artifact commit timestamp is an upper bound, NOT capture time.
date_semantics.domain_observedAt: WHOIS database update reference timestamp, NOT query/capture time.
date_semantics.assessment_asOf: Artifact publication upper bound; no temporal-generalization claim.

missingness: Unknown DNS addresses and redirect histories are represented by empty arrays; production feature zeros conflate unknown and absent.
unavailable_ablation: hybrid-v2: no independently timestamped threat-provider history; no full-hybrid claim.
split: Registered-domain-connected group split (seed 42); campaign IDs unavailable, registered domain proxy.
reuse_caveat: Repurposes the published evaluation subset into our own group train/validation/test partitions; not an original ScamFerret benchmark comparison.

source_metadata_audit.date_caveat: Git committer timestamp used as artifact upper bound; per-row capture time and GitHub first-publication/push time are unknown.
source_metadata_audit.recursive_tree_api_caveat: The cached recursive git/trees response identifies its requested commit ref in sha; the commit metadata separately supplies the Git tree object ID.
